field_principles.honest_verdict: terminal prefix; success: <game>_L<n>_offline_reproduced OR complete: <game>_delta_identified_no_bank (honest progress, not a bank).
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates -- offline arcade solve + verifier training, no headline LLM load (1s floor); declared so a fast real solve is not DURATION_TOO_SHORT false-flagged.
field_principles.offline_reproduced: a solve not reproducible offline is wasted effort -- only reproduced levels count toward reproducible_total_levels.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: records resources verified; pre-empts missing-resource fabrication.
field_principles.registry_updated: the per-game win-condition/action-model/gotchas/dead-ends persisted so the next attempt reuses, not re-derives.
field_principles.reproduced_levels: the integer new-level count banked this task (>=1 satisfies the level-up guarantee).
field_principles.target_game: the rotated game attempted -- traceable to the rotation discipline (not a game deepened in .420-.423).
field_principles.verifier_checkpoint_updated: the learned-verifier checkpoint trained on this run's pos/neg traces (the self-play self-improvement step the operator mandated every milestone).
